answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 26066 Country: United Kingdom Title: I would like to have the reference of hadith numbers of our hanfi style prayer, as many people here in london asking me to provide the details, if i cant provide the reference then i have to follow thier ways, please help me in this matter? Question: Assalamualaikum brother, i would like to have the reference of hadith numbers of our hanfi style prayer, as many people here in london asking me to provide the details, if i cant provide the reference then i have to follow thier ways, please help me in this matter, thank you, Allahafiz.. Answer ID: 26066 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1745/1376/B=1431) If you are an Aalim, you should study Bazl al-Majhud, I'ala al-Sunan and A'asar al-Sunan. And if you are not an Aalim, study these Urdu books: "Rasul Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam Ka Tariqa Namaz", by Maulana Jamil Ahmad Naziri and "Daleel Namaz", by Mufti Shoibullah Sahib Bangalori. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
